themes.name: Light (kept for later, no screen uses it yet)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: kept for later, no screen uses it yet. Game: every screen, set data-theme="game" on the screen root. Text on it: ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and cards sitting on surface. Text on it: ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised. 11.3:1 on light surface, 12.6:1 on white; white on the game surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on surface and surface-raised. 4.55:1 on the light surface, 5.1:1 on white; 7.6:1 on the game surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers, card outlines and card bottom edges. Never the only boundary of a control: use border-control or field-border for that.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outlines and edges of controls on surface and surface-raised. At least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs and leaderboard rows. White in both themes so inputs read the same on a purple game screen. Text on it: on-field.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text typed into inputs and text on leaderboard rows. On field: 12.6:1 (light), 15.9:1 (game).

tokens.name: on-field-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on field. 5.1:1.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input outline. Light: 3.7:1 on white and 3.3:1 on the light surface. Game: white against the purple ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Large brand fields (cover slab, brand badge). Shifts lighter in the game theme so it stays visible on the purple ground. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on brand. 11.8:1 on the light brand, 5.5:1 on the game brand.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Deepest purple. Decorative marks on brand fields (the cover pattern) and deep panels: 1.4:1 on the light brand by design, 3.4:1 on the game brand. Never text: text on a brand fill uses on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Lighter purple accents. Not for text on white (use ink).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main action fill. Light: blue button, text on-primary (5.4:1). Game: white button on the purple ground.

tokens.name: primary-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of the primary button and its hover and pressed states. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary. 5.4:1 (light), 15.9:1 (game).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of the secondary button: an action that is not the main one (edit, rename, view the report). The teal of avatar-teal, never an answer color. Text on it: on-secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of the secondary button and its hover and pressed states. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. 7.0:1.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Fill of the neutral button: cancel, close, back, previous, next. Game: lighter purple so it stays visible on surface and on surface-raised (cards, modals). Text on it: on-neutral.

tokens.name: neutral-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of the neutral button and its hover and pressed states. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-neutral
tokens.usage: Text on neutral. 12.6:1 (light), 5.5:1 (game).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Yellow: start-game button, first place, timer fill, focus ring in the game theme. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of accent fills. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent. 7.7:1. Never white on yellow.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill for destructive buttons and the red answer. Text on it: on-danger (4.7:1). As a mark it is 4.7:1 on white; do not use it as text on the game surface, use danger-text.

tokens.name: danger-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of danger fills. Also the cross mark on a white circle (7.8:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger. 4.7:1.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages as text. Light: 6.0:1 on white, 5.4:1 on the light surface. Game: 7.0:1 on the purple ground. Always with words or an icon.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill for save and confirm buttons and the green answer. Text on it: on-success (4.5:1).

tokens.name: success-edge
tokens.usage: Hard bottom edge of success fills. Also the check mark on a white circle (7.6:1).

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success. 4.5:1, so 16px bold or larger.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success messages as text. Light: 6.0:1 on white. Game: 9.0:1 on the purple ground. Always with words or an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Orange: third place on the podium and warnings. 3.2:1 on white, so a large fill or an icon, never body text. Text on it: on-warning.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning. 5.4:1. White fails on orange.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled controls and of answer tiles after the reveal that were not the answer.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and shapes on disabled fills. Exempt from contrast rules because disabled, still legible.

tokens.name: draft
tokens.usage: Fill of a draft card: a quiz or exam sheet being created and not saved yet. Grey, so it stands apart from the saved ones.

tokens.name: draft-edge
tokens.usage: Border and bottom edge of a draft card.

tokens.name: on-draft
tokens.usage: Text on a draft card. Light: 10.9:1, game: 8.6:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px outline with 2px offset on every focusable element. Light: 5.4:1 on white, 4.8:1 on the light surface. Game: 7.2:1 on the purple ground.

tokens.name: tile-red
tokens.usage: Answer tile 1, always with the triangle shape. Text: on-tile (4.7:1).

tokens.name: tile-red-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the red tile. Decorative.

tokens.name: tile-blue
tokens.usage: Answer tile 2, always with the diamond shape. Text: on-tile (5.4:1). Also second place and the default avatar.

tokens.name: tile-blue-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the blue tile. Decorative.

tokens.name: tile-yellow
tokens.usage: Answer tile 3, always with the circle shape. Text: on-tile-yellow (7.7:1).

tokens.name: tile-yellow-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the yellow tile. Decorative.

tokens.name: tile-green
tokens.usage: Answer tile 4, always with the square shape. Text: on-tile (4.5:1).

tokens.name: tile-green-edge
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the green tile. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Text and shapes on the red, blue and green tiles.

tokens.name: on-tile-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and shape on the yellow tile.

tokens.name: avatar-red
tokens.usage: Body of a red player character. Face: on-avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-red-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the red character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-blue
tokens.usage: Body of a blue player character. Face: on-avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-blue-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the blue character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-yellow
tokens.usage: Body of a yellow player character. Face: on-avatar-dark.

tokens.name: avatar-yellow-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the yellow character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-green
tokens.usage: Body of a green player character. Face: on-avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-green-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the green character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-orange
tokens.usage: Body of a orange player character. Face: on-avatar-dark.

tokens.name: avatar-orange-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the orange character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-purple
tokens.usage: Body of a purple player character. Face: on-avatar-dark.

tokens.name: avatar-purple-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the purple character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-pink
tokens.usage: Body of a pink player character. Face: on-avatar-dark.

tokens.name: avatar-pink-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the pink character. Decorative.

tokens.name: avatar-teal
tokens.usage: Body of a teal player character. Face: on-avatar-dark.

tokens.name: avatar-teal-edge
tokens.usage: 3px outline of the teal character. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-avatar
tokens.usage: Face on the red, blue and green characters. 4.7:1, 5.4:1 and 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-avatar-dark
tokens.usage: Face on the yellow, orange, purple, pink and teal characters. At least 5.4:1.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Host-screen headline, PIN on the lobby screen, podium rank numbers. Projector-sized.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title on player screens and the question text on the host screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in staff screens and the question text on player screens.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, answer tile text (weight 900 there), timer number.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, leaderboard rank.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Оюнга кирүү үчүн PIN кодду жазыңыз.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ар бир суроого 20 секунд убакыт бар.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper and error text under inputs, badges (weight 700), timestamps.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: The only all-caps text: small section labels. Apply text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its input, inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls and tiles; screen gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a form's groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding, stage padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Avatar and shape size.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input height, large breathing room.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom space on host screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner shapes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, answer tiles, leaderboard rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero slabs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, badges, avatars, the timer bar.

shadow.note: Hard bottom edges only. No blurred shadows.

tokens.name: edge-primary
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the primary button.

tokens.name: edge-accent
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the accent button.

tokens.name: edge-danger
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the danger button.

tokens.name: edge-success
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the success button.

tokens.name: edge-secondary
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the secondary button.

tokens.name: edge-neutral
tokens.usage: Resting edge of the neutral button.
